title: Left route on a pinned tensor summand
statement: Fix schemes $X,X',S,S'$, morphisms $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$, and a cartesian square $sq:\operatorname{IsPullback}(g',f',f,g)$. Assume the derived-category instances of the module-sheaf categories. Let $P,Q$ be arbitrary integer cochain complexes of module sheaves on $X$, $N$ such a complex on $X'$, $H_0=\operatorname{tensorPullback}(g')$ the module pullback functor, $H$ its degreewise extension, and $a:HQ\to N$ a chain map. At $z\in X'$ put $R=\mathcal O_{S,f(g'z)}$, $A=\mathcal O_{X,g'z}$, $B=\mathcal O_{S',f'z}$, $C=\mathcal O_{X',z}$, with the algebra maps induced by the square [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let $b:A\to A\otimes_R B\to C$ be the resulting composite ring map, $G=\operatorname{extendScalars}(b)$, $F=G$ applied degreewise, $T$ the stalk functor at $g'z$ on $X$, $S$ the stalk functor at $z$ on $X'$ applied degreewise, $U=T(P)$ and $V=T(Q)$. Write $\kappa_L=\operatorname{tensorStalkIso}(f,f',g,g',sq,z,L):F(TL)\cong S(HL)$ for the specified pullback-stalk comparison. Let $e_{L,M}:T\operatorname{Tot}(L\otimes M)\cong TL\otimes TM$ and $e'_{L,M}:S\operatorname{Tot}(L\otimes M)\cong SL\otimes SM$ be the chosen pinned stalk tensor comparisons [lem-pc-tensor-pullback-stalk-square], characterized on each summand by the canonical module tensor-stalk comparison. Define $\sigma=e_{P,Q}^{-1}$, $t=\kappa_Q;S(a)$ and $\rho=(\kappa_P\otimes1_{SN});(e'_{HP,N})^{-1}$. Suppose $\chi:H\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(HP\otimes HQ)$ satisfies $H_0(\iota_{P,Q}^{p,q,n});\chi_n=c_{P^p,Q^q};\iota_{HP,HQ}^{p,q,n}$ for every $p+q=n$, where $c$ is the chosen module pullback tensor isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor]. For integers $n,p,q$ with $p+q=n$, let $j=G(\iota_{U,V}^{p,q,n})$. Then $j;(F(\sigma);\kappa_{\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)};S(\chi;(1\otimes a)))_n=\delta_G(U^p,V^q);(\kappa_{P,p}\otimes\kappa_{Q,q});(1\otimes S(a)_q);\iota_{SHP,SN}^{p,q,n};(e'_{HP,N})^{-1}_n$.

proof.text: Invert the pinned source injection formula by cancelling e.hom_n and map it under G. Rewrite κ_Total,n with its specified module pullback-stalk component. Transport the extension ring map b to g'.stalkMap using its restriction equation. Naturality of the module pullback-stalk isomorphism supplies the source summand square. Map hχ under the target stalk functor, and use the mapBifunctorMap summand formula for identity tensor a. The target pinned injection formula and the module tensor-stalk naturality formula supply the next two squares. Apply the proved module_pinned_tensor_stalk_square to P.X p and Q.X q, transported along b=g'.stalkMap. A categorical diagram chase combines these six equations: postcompose with e'.hom_n, substitute the equations successively, and cancel e'.inv_n;e'.hom_n. This calculation involves one summand only and does not use coproduct extensionality.
